result.summary: The page is generally well rendered, but several horizontally scrollable elements are visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation is partially obstructed by the system gesture indicator.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off on the right: an unlabeled partial chip is visible after “Healthy,” making the carousel look abruptly clipped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate right-side padding/peek treatment and ensure the next category chip is visibly identifiable, or constrain the row so it does not show an ambiguous clipped fragment.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel is visibly cropped on the right. The third restaurant card and its title (“Trattoria Piccol…”) are truncated by the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel spacing and a deliberate partial-card affordance, or resize cards so complete content is shown; ensure titles are ellipsized cleanly within their card rather than clipped by the screen.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the device gesture/home indicator area. The dark gesture bar crosses over the search tab icon and the nav labels/icons are cut off at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset by increasing the bottom navigation’s padding/height or placing it above the system navigation area.

issues.description: The second “Popular right now” restaurant card is only partially visible at the bottom of the viewport, with no restaurant details shown before the navigation bar begins.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing/list behavior so cards are either presented with their associated details or clearly continue below the fold without appearing obscured by the fixed navigation.
